<!--
Element: To-do checklist
ID: 014 · Category: Toggles & Pickers · Tags: checkbox, todo, strike, progress, list
What it does: Check an item and the circle fills with color, a check is drawn, then a strike-through sweeps across the task from the left. The progress ring at the top fills along, and turns into a done mark when everything is finished.
How to use it: Check the tasks one by one. Space works too
Footprint: fixed size, square
Needs: tokens.css (the --ux-* theme tokens and the .ux base). Map the tokens to the project's theme variables.
Live demo: https://lucianlabs.dev/uxui-prompt/#014
-->
<style>
.u014{position:relative;width:330px;padding:22px 22px 14px;border-radius:28px;background:var(--ux-surface);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ux-line),0 30px 60px -36px var(--ux-shadow-strong)}
.u014-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px}
.u014-head b{display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.u014-sub{position:relative;display:block;width:210px;height:19px;margin-top:4px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ux-ink-3)}
.u014-sub span{display:block;line-height:19px;transition:transform .5s var(--ux-spring),opacity .3s var(--ux-ease)}
.u014-sub span+span{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform:translateY(100%);opacity:0;color:var(--ux-mint);font-weight:650}
.u014.is-all .u014-sub span:first-child{transform:translateY(-100%);opacity:0}
.u014.is-all .u014-sub span+span{transform:none;opacity:1}
.u014-ring{position:relative;width:48px;height:48px;flex:none}
.u014-ring svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.u014-ring circle{fill:none;stroke-width:5;stroke-linecap:round}
.u014-ring .bg{stroke:var(--ux-surface-3)}
.u014-ring .fg{stroke:var(--ux-accent);stroke-dasharray:125.7;stroke-dashoffset:calc(125.7 * (1 - var(--p,0)));transition:stroke-dashoffset .7s var(--ux-spring),stroke .4s var(--ux-ease)}
.u014.is-all .u014-ring .fg{stroke:var(--ux-mint)}
.u014-num{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:760;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;transition:opacity .3s,transform .5s var(--ux-spring)}
.u014-done{position:absolute;inset:9px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--ux-mint);color:var(--ux-accent-ink);transform:scale(0);transition:transform .55s var(--ux-spring)}
.u014-done svg{width:16px;height:16px;transform:none;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.u014.is-all .u014-num{opacity:0;transform:scale(.5)}
.u014.is-all .u014-done{transform:none}
.u014-list{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.u014-row{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 4px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;border-top:1px solid var(--ux-line)}
.u014-in{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px;pointer-events:none}
.u014-box{position:relative;width:26px;height:26px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ux-line-2);transition:box-shadow .3s var(--ux-ease),transform .45s var(--ux-spring)}
.u014-box::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#8B6CFF,#5B8CFF);transform:scale(0);transition:transform .45s var(--ux-spring)}
.u014-box svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.u014-box path{stroke-dasharray:18;stroke-dashoffset:18;transition:stroke-dashoffset .35s var(--ux-ease)}
.u014-row:hover .u014-box{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ux-accent)}
.u014-row:active .u014-box{transform:scale(.86)}
.u014-in:focus-visible+.u014-box{outline:2px solid var(--ux-accent);outline-offset:3px}
.u014-in:checked+.u014-box{box-shadow:none}
.u014-in:checked+.u014-box::before{transform:scale(1)}
.u014-in:checked+.u014-box path{stroke-dashoffset:0;transition-delay:.12s}
.u014-t{position:relative;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ux-ink);transition:color .4s var(--ux-ease)}
.u014-t::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-2px;right:-2px;top:52%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--ux-ink-3);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0 50%;transition:transform .45s var(--ux-ease)}
.u014-in:checked~.u014-t{color:var(--ux-ink-3)}
.u014-in:checked~.u014-t::after{transform:scaleX(1);transition-delay:.18s}
.u014-tag{margin-left:auto;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--k) 15%,transparent);color:var(--k);white-space:nowrap;transition:opacity .4s var(--ux-ease)}
.u014-in:checked~.u014-tag{opacity:.4}
</style>
<div class="ux u014">
  <div class="u014-head">
    <div>

  <ul class="u014-list">

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
  var ins = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.u014-in'));
  var num = root.querySelector('.u014-num');
  function update() {
    var n = ins.filter(function (i) { return i.checked; }).length;
    root.style.setProperty('--p', (n / ins.length).toFixed(3));
    num.textContent = n + '/' + ins.length;
    root.classList.toggle('is-all', n === ins.length);
  }
  ins.forEach(function (i) { i.addEventListener('change', update); });
  update();
})();
</script>
